thread.title: Video Game Stocks Glu Mobile, Zynga Upgraded | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Video Game Stocks Glu Mobile, Zynga Upgraded | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Mobile video game publishers Glu Mobile ( GLUU ) and Zynga ( ZNGA ) have returned to favor among some on Wall Street as both video game stocks received upgrades this week from analysts.
X Macquarie Capital on Tuesday upgraded Zynga to outperform from neutral and raised its price target to 4.65 from 4. Cowen on Monday named Glu Mobile to its list of "best ideas for 2019" and upped its price target to 9.50 from 8.
Glu Mobile stock rose 7.3% to 8.08 on the stock market today . It returned to the buy zone , which it breached on Nov. 7 when breaking out of a nine-week consolidation period .
Zynga stock fell 0.8% to 3.64 on Tuesday. It is trading below its 50-day and 200-day moving average lines, a negative technical trading sign.

He also sees the potential for lower app-store commissions to increase 2020 earnings by 37% to 67% — before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization. He sees legal, regulatory and competitive pressures forcing Apple ( AAPL ) and Alphabet 's ( GOOGL ) Google to change their current 70/30 app commission model.
Schachter noted that this is the first time he's been positive on the stock since its initial public offering in late 2011.
Zynga has eight new games in development, with three or four launching in the second half of 2019, he said. Its core games today include "CSR Racing 2," "Words With Friends" and "Zynga Poker."
"The new management team at Zynga has turned the business around over the past two years, and operationally, has put Zynga in the best position it's been in for a very, very long time," Schachter said.
Zynga's focus will shift from fixing the business to growing the business in 2019, Jefferies analyst Timothy O'Shea said in a report Sunday. He rates Zynga as buy with a price target of 5.25.
Glu Mobile Games Pipeline Called 'Exciting' Cowen analyst Doug Creutz reiterated his outperform rating on Glu Mobile on Monday.
"Execution on the core business has been excellent for the last two years, the company has an exciting 2019 product pipeline, and valuation remains reasonable given significant earnings leverage against expected revenue growth," Creutz said in a report.
New management at Glu has turned around the company's prospects, he said.
"We expect profitability to continue to improve, particularly as the company's new product pipeline comes online in 2019," Creutz said. Expected new games include "WWE: Universe," "Diner Dash Town" and a Disney Pixar game.
